c4isr_products.name: AuterionOS
c4isr_products.description: Commercial distribution of the open-source PX4 autopilot plus containerized app framework; positioned as an OS that unifies fleets from multiple manufacturers so one operator can control many vehicles.

c4isr_products.name: Skynode S / Skynode X
c4isr_products.description: Skynode S: 38 g onboard AI computer combining flight controller, vision processing and encrypted radio that converts manually flown FPV drones into autonomous terminal-guidance systems (locks and tracks moving targets to ~1 km under GPS/comms jamming). Skynode X: all-in-one autopilot + mission computer.
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: camera video, IMU, RF link. Process: onboard target lock/track and navigation in denied environments. Output: autonomous terminal guidance. User: FPV strike crews (Ukraine), allied forces.

c4isr_products.name: Nemyx
c4isr_products.description: Swarm/mission-autonomy engine built on AuterionOS: one operator selects targets and the software handles navigation, formation control, deconfliction and terminal guidance across many heterogeneous drones; reassigns targets if a drone is lost.
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: operator mission parameters and weapons-release authorization; drone telemetry. Process: multi-vehicle task allocation and coordination. Output: coordinated strikes/ISR. User: small units (one operator, many drones).

c4isr_products.name: MAVSDK / Auterion SDK / px4-ros2-interface-lib
c4isr_products.description: Open-source (BSD-3) MAVLink API (C++, Python, Swift, Java, JS, Rust, C#) using gRPC/protobuf; ROS 2-based SDK for onboard apps; library for external flight modes from a companion computer.
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: MAVLink telemetry/commands. Process: high-level API abstraction. Output: apps and GCS integrations. User: third-party developers and integrators.

companies.exact_problem_solved: Makes cheap mass-produced drones from many manufacturers autonomous and interoperable (target lock in jammed/GPS-denied conditions) and lets a single operator command many of them (swarming) without changing airframes.
